Title: Generally available: Azure Digital Twins in West US 3, Qatar, Japan, and Korea

Body.Content: Azure Digital Twins enables you to create a digital representation of real-world things, places, business processes, and people. Gain insights that help you drive better products, optimize operations and costs, and create breakthrough customer experiences. For more information, visit the Azure Digital Twins webpage.
